paper.title: Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled powerful software engineering (SE) agents capable of navigating complex codebases and resolving real-world issues. However, these agents remain fundamentally episodic: they fail to retain, refine, and reuse experiences across tasks, repeatedly reconstructing context from scratch and reproducing similar mistakes. Even with memory support, they offer no remedy for the absence of a principled, task-agnostic \textit{memory utility}, making them difficult to

summary.core_problem: 现有的软件工程（SE）Agent 通常是片段式的，缺乏跨任务保留、提炼和重用经验的机制；而现有的记忆增强方法缺乏与下游任务表现挂钩的、任务无关的记忆效用评估标准。
summary.importance: 提出了一个闭环的记忆优化框架 MemOp，将记忆效用严格定义为对下游任务性能的因果提升，为 Agent 记忆机制的评估和无监督优化提供了原则性方法。
summary.technical_approach: MemOp 包含两个核心创新：1) 将记忆效用定义为双重工具：既是评估基准，也是优化信号，完全基于下游任务的实际表现。2) 闭环记忆优化：通过轨迹级反思从完成的任务中提取候选记忆，然后通过性能验证（测量其对下游结果的因果影响）将候选记忆转化为训练信号，从而在无外部监督的情况下自适应地优化记忆模型。
summary.experiments: 在单回合记忆生成和跨回合记忆演化两种设置下进行了评估。结果表明，MemOp 显著提升了 SE Agent 的性能（成功率绝对提升高达 5.25%），训练后的记忆模型能生成高质量的反思，并具有很强的适应性，同时大幅降低了计算成本（相对降低 $\ge 9.79\%$）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第 2 节（MemOp 框架）和第 3 节（记忆效用的定义与闭环优化机制）。理解其如何将“记忆是否有用”转化为可计算的因果影响，这对于设计具备持续学习能力的复杂 Agent 架构非常有价值。
summary.authors_note: Xuehang Guo (William & Mary), Xingyao Wang (OpenHands)

summary_en.core_problem: Current Software Engineering (SE) agents are episodic, lacking mechanisms to retain, refine, and reuse experience across tasks. Existing memory-augmented approaches lack a task-agnostic utility metric tied to downstream performance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes MemOp, a closed-loop memory optimization framework that strictly defines memory utility as the causal improvement on downstream task performance, providing a principled approach for evaluating and unsupervisedly optimizing agent memory mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemOp introduces two key innovations: 1) Principled memory utility as a dual harness: serving as both an evaluation benchmark and an optimization signal, grounded entirely in downstream performance. 2) Closed-loop memory optimization: candidate memories are distilled from completed trajectories via reflection, and then validated by measuring their causal impact on downstream outcomes. This validation converts candidates into training signals, enabling adaptive memory optimization without external supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated under single-episode memory generation and cross-episode memory evolution settings. MemOp significantly improves SE agent performance (up to 5.25% absolute increase in Success Rate). The trained memory models produce high-quality reflections, exhibit robust adaptability, and substantially reduce computational costs ($\ge 9.79\%$ relative reduction).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (MemOp framework) and Section 3 (definition of memory utility and closed-loop optimization). Understand how it translates 'memory usefulness' into a computable causal impact, which is highly valuable for designing complex agents with continual learning capabilities.
summary_en.authors_note: Xuehang Guo (William & Mary), Xingyao Wang (OpenHands)

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“memory 有用”定义成可验证下游收益这一步很干净；只看任务定义和评测协议，别在代码 Agent 细节上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the move of defining memory utility via validated downstream impact is unusually clean; read the task formulation and eval protocol, not the code-agent plumbing.

paper.title: WRIT: Write-Read Intensive Trajectory Synthesis for Multi-Turn User-Facing Agents

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作面向多轮用户代理，试图解决训练轨迹稀缺或质量不足的问题，通过合成 write-read intensive 的交互轨迹来提升 agent 在多轮场景中的表现。
summary.importance: 它的价值主要在 agent 训练数据构造，而不是基座预训练本身。对预训练研究员的相关性来自一个间接问题：多轮交互中的状态写入、历史读取和外部记忆使用，是否需要专门的数据分布来学到。
summary.technical_approach: 从标题看，方法核心是 trajectory synthesis：围绕“写入信息—后续读取—跨轮使用”构造更密集的训练轨迹，可能包含用户澄清、状态更新、记忆回溯和工具结果再利用等模式。更像是后训练/agent 数据工程，而非新架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要缺失，无法确认所用基座模型、训练数据规模、agent 环境和基线。合理预期是与普通 SFT 轨迹、单轮指令数据或弱多轮数据相比，在多轮任务成功率、上下文利用率或长期一致性上有提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 North Carolina State University 和 Case Western Reserve University。未见可确认的头部 agent 团队标识。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets multi-turn user-facing agents and tries to address the lack or low quality of training trajectories by synthesizing write-read intensive interaction traces.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is in agent training data construction rather than foundation-model pretraining. For pretraining researchers, the indirect relevance is whether multi-turn state writing, later retrieval, and memory use require a specially shaped training distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: From the title, the core method is trajectory synthesis: generating interactions with dense write-then-read patterns, likely including clarification turns, state updates, memory recall, and reuse of prior tool outputs. This looks more like post-training or agent data engineering than a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is unavailable, so the base models, data scale, environments, and baselines cannot be confirmed. A reasonable expectation is comparison against standard SFT trajectories, single-turn instruction data, or weaker multi-turn data, with gains in task success, context utilization, or long-horizon consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with North Carolina State University and Case Western Reserve University. No clearly identifiable flagship agent lab can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 偏 agent 数据工程，和 pretrain 关系不深；若你在做 continual/SFT 接口，可只看轨迹合成模板，正文大概率不用细读。
recommendation.en: This is mostly agent-side data engineering, not core pretraining; if you care about the pretrain-to-SFT interface, skim the trajectory synthesis templates and move on.

paper.title: COLLEAGUE.SKILL: Automated AI Skill Generation via Expert Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly expected not only to complete isolated tasks, but also to carry bounded representations of human expertise, judgment, and interaction style. Building such person-grounded agents remains difficult because actionable knowledge associated with a person or role is usually embedded in heterogeneous traces rather than written as clean instructions. Existing memory and persona systems capture fragments of this evidence, while skill frameworks provide portable packaging forma

summary.core_problem: 把某个人或某个角色的零散工作痕迹，自动蒸馏成可检查、可修正、可被 agent 调用的技能包。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 agent 技能工程和知识蒸馏工作流，而不是基座模型训练方法。它试图解决 persona、memory、skill framework 之间缺少端到端转换链路的问题，对通用 agent 记忆和技能封装有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 系统从目标人物或角色的异构材料中抽取可操作知识，生成带版本管理的 skill package。技能包分成两条轨道：capability track 记录实践方法、心智模型和决策启发式；bounded behavior track 约束沟通风格和行为边界。方法更像 trace-to-skill 的自动化蒸馏流水线，而非新的模型训练目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据量、具体 benchmark 或定量提升。可确认的是系统面向 person-grounded agents，强调生成结果的 inspectable、correctable 和 agent-usable。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海人工智能实验室等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets automatic conversion of a person’s heterogeneous traces into inspectable, editable, and agent-usable skill packages.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an agent-skill engineering workflow rather than a foundation-model training method. The useful angle is the attempt to connect persona evidence, memory fragments, and portable skill frameworks into one distillation pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: COLLEAGUE.SKILL ingests materials associated with a target person or role and produces a versioned skill package. The package separates capability knowledge, such as practices and decision heuristics, from bounded behavioral constraints such as interaction style and role-specific limits.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale, dataset size, concrete baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to focus on whether generated skills are usable and correctable for person-grounded agents.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 技能封装方案知道即可；对预训练研究的可迁移信息有限，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as an agent skill-packaging workflow, but it offers little signal for pretraining research.

paper.title: Ask Now, Use Later: Benchmarking the Proactivity Gap in Long-Lived LLM Agents
paper.abstract: A long-lived LLM agent, such as OpenClaw, earns its value by acting on a user's preferences and constraints across sessions, not just the current request. Yet today's agents keep what a user volunteers but rarely ask for what stays unspoken, leaving a proactivity gap in long-lived LLM agents: an agent cannot act on a preference it never obtained. As users delegate more of their affairs to agents, the impact of this gap grows. We isolate one concrete, controllable slice of this gap as Ask-to-Reme

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论长生命周期 LLM Agent 的“主动获取用户偏好”问题。现有个性化 Agent 多数只保存用户已经说出的信息，或在当前任务需要时才澄清；但真实委托场景里，很多稳定偏好要到未来任务才会影响行动。论文把这个缺口收窄为 Ask-to-Remember：Agent 是否应该在当前会话中主动询问一个当前任务不需要、但未来可能复用的用户偏好。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对 Agent 评测和长期记忆训练信号有启发。它把“记忆”从被动存储推进到主动采集，强调长期个性化能力不能只评测检索、写入和调用，还要评测何时值得向用户索取信息。这个视角会影响后续 Agent post-training 数据构造：训练样本不应只包含当前任务最优动作，还应包含延迟收益下的信息获取决策。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 ATRBench，将难以直接评测的长期主动询问问题拆成可控 episode。每个 episode 有隐藏的用户稳定偏好，评测器可见但 Agent 不可见；早期交互上下文保持自然，不直接暴露目标偏好，从而避免把任务退化成记忆读取。随后，每个隐藏偏好绑定一个未来任务，未来任务的正确行为依赖该偏好。这样可以把早期是否询问、是否获得答案、后续是否正确使用答案分开评估。相比普通澄清问题，ATR 的问题不服务当前任务；相比记忆 benchmark，ATR 不假设偏好已经进入用户画像，而是要求 Agent 自己发现有信息缺口。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了 8 个 frontier LLM agents。结果显示，若给 Agent oracle 访问相关用户偏好，未来任务准确率可提升 62.1 到 76.6 个百分点，说明隐藏偏好确实控制了后续任务表现；但通过提示词鼓励 Agent 主动询问，最多只能恢复该 gap 的 15.5%。这个结果说明当前模型不是简单缺少提示，而是在识别“未来可复用偏好”、权衡打扰成本、形成可操作问题上都较弱。论文的关键实验价值在于把 oracle 上限、主动询问收益和最终应用能力拆开，而不是只看最终任务成功率。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 proactivity gap 和 ATR 的定义，以及 Problem Formulation 中用户隐藏状态、用户模型 gap、跨会话 substrate 的形式化。实验部分优先看 oracle access 与 prompting intervention 的对比表，关注它如何区分 acquisition failure 和 application failure。若关心 Agent 训练数据，可重点看 benchmark 构造方式：隐藏偏好如何设计，未来任务如何绑定，评分如何避免把“会问问题”误判为“会长期个性化”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in long-lived LLM agents: they preserve what users volunteer, but rarely ask for stable preferences that are not needed now and may matter later. It formalizes this as Ask-to-Remember, where an agent must decide whether to ask a reusable preference question in the current session even though the payoff appears only in a future task.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is useful for designing agent training and evaluation signals. It shifts long-term personalization from passive memory storage to active information acquisition. This matters for post-training data: future agent datasets should not only label the best action for the current task, but also label when asking a user for latent reusable information is worthwhile under delayed utility.
summary_en.technical_approach: ATRBench makes the problem measurable by constructing controlled episodes with hidden user preferences. The evaluator knows these preferences, while the agent only sees ordinary interaction contexts under the same persona. The hidden preference is then tied to a later task whose correct behavior depends on that preference. This design separates three capabilities: asking early, storing or propagating the answer, and applying it later. The distinction from clarification benchmarks is important: the question is not needed to finish the current task. The distinction from memory benchmarks is also important: the relevant preference is not assumed to already exist in the agent’s memory.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is evaluated on eight frontier LLM agents. Oracle access to the relevant preference improves future-task accuracy by 62.1 to 76.6 percentage points, confirming that the withheld preference is decisive for the later task. Prompting-based interventions recover at most 15.5% of this gap. The main empirical message is that current agents do not merely need a stronger instruction to ask questions; they struggle to identify future-reusable preference gaps and convert them into useful low-cost questions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the introduction for the definition of the proactivity gap and Ask-to-Remember. Then read the problem formulation for the latent user state, user-model gap, and cross-session substrate. In the experiments, focus on the oracle versus prompting comparisons and on how the benchmark separates acquisition from later application. For agent post-training work, the most useful part is the episode construction: hidden preferences, future preference-bound tasks, and scoring design.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain，但它把“长期 agent 为什么总像被动客服”测成了一个干净任务；若你做 memory/RL agent，只看任务定义和 failure taxonomy 就值回时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it turns the vague complaint that long-lived agents act like passive clerks into a clean task; if you work on memory or RL agents, the task definition and failure taxonomy are worth reading.

paper.title: When Does Memory Help Multi-Trajectory Inference for Tool-Use LLM Agents?
paper.abstract: Multi-trajectory inference for tool-use LLM agents - generating multiple reasoning attempts and selecting among them - benefits from transferring knowledge across attempts so that later ones avoid the pitfalls of earlier ones. Existing cross-trajectory memory methods (trajectory-level reflection, atomic fact extraction, raw observation injection) are each evaluated under a single inference strategy on a single task, making it unclear whether reported gains reflect properties of the memory abstra

summary.core_problem: 现有工具型LLM Agent的多轨迹推理跨轨迹记忆方法，仅在单一推理策略、单一任务下评估，无法明确性能提升来自记忆抽象本身还是推理方法的特性，且未覆盖无内联验证器的实际部署场景。
summary.importance: 系统拆解了多轨迹记忆的完整设计空间，明确了记忆效果与推理策略、任务属性的匹配规律，为工具型Agent的推理优化提供了可落地的设计参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出统一框架，将多轨迹记忆沿两个正交轴拆解：转移范围（同节点扩展内的兄弟候选间转移、跨完整轨迹转移）和转移内容的抽象层级，派生出4种具体记忆方法；在无内联验证器的部署友好设置下，对4种记忆方法、3种推理策略（best-of-N、波束搜索、MCTS）、4个基准任务做全覆盖组合评估。
summary.experiments: 得到三个核心结论：1）记忆的准确率效果依赖搜索方法，反射式记忆仅在MCTS下有显著提升，兄弟候选内容注入仅能改善波束搜索的多样性不足问题；2）在难度较高的KGQA基准的MCTS设置下，反射式记忆和原始兄弟内容注入的准确率无统计显著差异；3）事实提取式记忆不影响准确率，但在存在可复用环境结构的任务上可提升推理效率。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注框架的双轴设计空间拆解部分和第5章的实验结论。泛读预计耗时12分钟，可跳过具体测试环境的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing cross-trajectory memory methods for multi-trajectory inference of tool-use LLM agents are only evaluated under a single inference strategy and single task, making it impossible to distinguish whether performance gains come from memory abstraction itself or properties of the inference method. They also do not cover practical deployment scenarios without inline verifiers.
summary_en.importance: It systematically decomposes the full design space of multi-trajectory memory, clarifies the matching rules between memory effectiveness, inference strategies and task properties, and provides actionable design references for inference optimization of tool-use agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: A unified framework is proposed that decomposes multi-trajectory memory along two orthogonal axes: transfer scope (transfer between sibling candidates within the same node expansion, cross complete trajectory transfer) and abstraction level of transferred content, from which 4 concrete memory methods are derived. Full combinatorial evaluation is conducted across 4 memory methods, 3 inference strategies (best-of-N, beam search, MCTS), and 4 benchmarks under a deployment-friendly verifier-free setting.
summary_en.experiments: Three core findings are obtained: 1) The accuracy effect of memory depends on the search method: reflection-style memory only brings significant improvements under MCTS, while cross-sibling content injection only alleviates the diversity shortage of beam search; 2) Under MCTS on the harder KGQA benchmark, there is no statistically significant accuracy difference between reflection-style memory and raw sibling injection; 3) Fact-extraction memory does not affect accuracy, but improves efficiency on tasks with reusable environmental structure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the two-axis design space decomposition of the framework and experimental findings in Section 5. Skim reading takes approximately 12 minutes; implementation details of specific test environments can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: 值得看结果矩阵；关键不是“memory 有用”，而是哪种抽象在无 verifier 搜索里不添乱。
recommendation.en: Read the result matrix; the real question is not whether memory helps, but which abstraction avoids harming verifier-free search.

paper.title: Anticipate and Learn: Unleashing Idle-Time Compute in Proactive Agents
paper.abstract: While AI agents demonstrate remarkable capabilities in reasoning and tool use, they remain fundamentally reactive: they compute responses only after explicit user prompts. This paradigm ignores a critical opportunity: the idle time between interactions is largely wasted, leaving agents unable to prepare for future user needs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ProAct, a proactive agent architecture that leverages idle-time compute to anticipate and fulfill likely upcoming user needs. By analyzing

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 agent 只在用户发问后被动计算、无法利用交互空闲时间提前准备的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献一半在 agent 架构，一半在评测资产。对基座预训练本身不直接，但对 test-time compute 分配、长期记忆和主动式系统设计有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProAct：在 idle time 内结合对话历史与持久记忆预测用户下一步需求，主动补齐知识缺口、检索证据并预先准备答案；同时构建 ProActEval，覆盖 40 个领域、200 个场景，用于评估 proactive capability。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种场景下显著优于被动式基线，但未给出底座模型、工具配置、成本开销、成功率提升幅度等关键细节。若看论文，重点应放在 benchmark 设计和 idle-time compute 的收益/成本曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the limitation that current agents are reactive: they only compute after a user prompt and waste idle time between interactions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is split between an agent architecture and an evaluation asset. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to test-time compute allocation, persistent memory, and proactive system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ProAct, which uses dialogue history plus persistent memory during idle time to predict likely future user needs, gather missing information, and prepare evidence in advance. It also introduces ProActEval with 200 scenarios across 40 domains for proactive-agent evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims significant gains over reactive baselines, but does not provide key details such as the base model, tool stack, cost overhead, or exact improvement margins. If reading, focus on the benchmark design and the benefit-vs-cost curve of idle-time compute.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深；若关心 test-time scaling，就只看 benchmark 设计与空闲算力收益曲线，方法本身偏系统工程。
recommendation.en: Not very close to pretraining; if you care about test-time scaling, read the benchmark design and the idle-compute tradeoff, since the method itself is mostly systems work.

paper.title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on reusable skills to solve complex tasks. However, existing skill creation approaches treat skills as isolated and static artifacts, limiting their reusability, reliability, and long-term improvement. We propose MUSE-Autoskill Agent (Memory-Utilizing Skill Evolution), a skill-centric agent framework that lets agents continuously improve their task-solving capability by creating, reusing, and refining skills under a unified lifecycle (creation, memory, mana

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 的技能创建、复用、管理和持续改进彼此割裂的问题，使技能不再是一次性静态产物。
summary.importance: 这是通用 agent 框架工作，贡献在 skill lifecycle 管理，而不是基座模型训练。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但它提供了一个可观察的 post-train/agent memory 设计点：把经验沉淀到 skill 级别，而不是只沉淀到对话级别。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MUSE-Autoskill，将技能生命周期统一为 creation、memory、management、evaluation 和 refinement。系统支持按需创建技能、跨任务存储和复用、组织与选择技能，并通过单元测试和运行时反馈持续修正。额外引入 skill-level memory，累积每个技能跨任务的经验，以提升复用和适配效果。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 SkillsBench 上，摘要称生命周期管理的技能能提升任务表现，但未给出模型规模、训练数据、强基线和提升幅度。更像 agent framework 的初步证据，而不是足够干净的能力归因研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the fragmentation between skill creation, reuse, management, and continual improvement in LLM agents, so that skills are no longer static one-off artifacts.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent framework paper, with the main contribution in skill lifecycle management rather than foundation-model training. Its value to pretraining researchers is limited, though it offers one useful post-train/agent-memory idea: storing experience at the skill level rather than only at the dialogue level.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes MUSE-Autoskill, unifying the skill lifecycle into creation, memory, management, evaluation, and refinement. The system supports on-demand skill creation, cross-task storage and reuse, organization and selection, and continual refinement through unit tests and runtime feedback. It also introduces skill-level memory that accumulates experience for each skill across tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are mainly on SkillsBench. The abstract claims that lifecycle-managed skills improve task performance, but it does not provide model scale, training data, strong baselines, or effect sizes. This reads more like initial framework evidence than a clean capability attribution study.

recommendation.zh: agent memory/skill 库方向的常规推进，和基座预训练不直接相连；只看技能生命周期设计即可，实验先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: This is a fairly standard step in agent memory/skill libraries, not tightly connected to foundation pretraining; read the lifecycle design and treat the experiments as weak evidence.

paper.title: SMMBench: A Benchmark for Source-Distributed Multimodal Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Existing benchmarks for multimodal memory reasoning largely evaluate systems within pre-assembled contexts, but under-evaluate whether agents can use evidence distributed across independently originated sources. We argue that source-distributed memory composition is an important and under-examined bottleneck in multimodal agent memory, especially when relevant evidence is fragmented across heterogeneous artifacts such as conversations, profiles, screenshots, tables, images, and documents. To add

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态 agent memory benchmark 过度依赖预组装上下文、低估跨独立来源证据拼接能力的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。它把“source-distributed memory composition”单独拎出来测，强调真实 agent 需要跨对话、截图、表格、文档、图像等异构来源检索并对齐证据。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但对评估多模态 agent 的记忆瓶颈有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SMMBench，围绕四类能力构建评测：跨源多模态推理、冲突消解、偏好推理、基于记忆的动作预测。核心不是新模型，而是更贴近真实使用场景的数据组织方式：证据分散在多个独立来源，而不是被人工拼成单一上下文。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 1877 个样本、264 个来源。摘要说明做了实验比较，但未给出具体参评模型、是否包含闭源强模型、以及不同 memory / retrieval 策略的误差分解。若只想获取信息，重点应看 benchmark 构造原则和错误类型统计，而不是逐项分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交通大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a gap in multimodal agent-memory evaluation: existing benchmarks often provide pre-assembled context and under-test whether agents can compose evidence scattered across independently originated sources.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. Its main value is isolating source-distributed memory composition as a distinct bottleneck for multimodal agents. For pretraining researchers, the relevance is modest, but it is useful as an evaluation reference for memory-heavy multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: SMMBench evaluates four capabilities: cross-source multimodal reasoning, conflict resolution, preference reasoning, and memory-grounded action prediction. The novelty is in benchmark construction rather than model design: evidence is distributed across heterogeneous sources such as conversations, screenshots, tables, images, and documents instead of being curated into a single context.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,877 samples grounded in 264 sources. The abstract indicates comparative experiments, but does not specify the participating models, whether frontier closed models are included, or how errors break down across retrieval versus reasoning failures. The most useful parts are likely the benchmark design and failure analysis rather than leaderboard numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and collaborators.

recommendation.zh: 是个评测集，不会直接改你的训练配方；只看任务定义和 error taxonomy，判断自家 agent 是否真在做跨源证据拼接。
recommendation.en: This is a benchmark, not a training-method paper; only read the task design and error taxonomy to check whether your agent truly composes cross-source evidence.

paper.title: Retrieval from Within: An Intrinsic Capability of Attention-Based Models
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically treats retrieval and generation as separate systems. We ask whether an attention-based encoder-decoder can instead retrieve directly from its own internal representations. We introduce INTRA (INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention), a framework where decoder attention queries score pre-encoded evidence chunks that are then directly reused as context for generation. By construction, INTRA unifies retrieval and generation, eliminating the retriever-generat

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是 RAG 中检索器和生成器分离带来的表示错配与重复编码成本：外部 retriever 用一套表示选择证据，generator 再把选中的文本重新消费。作者问的是，encoder-decoder 模型能否直接用自身 attention 表示完成证据检索，并把同一份 encoded evidence 用于生成。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对架构和统一检索-生成接口有启发。它强调 attention 的 query-conditioned matching 可以作为检索接口，而不一定要把 retrieval 做成外部系统。这个方向对长上下文、记忆增强模型、encoder-decoder 预训练目标有参考价值：如果 evidence chunk 的 encoder states 可以被预计算并跨 query 复用，那么检索与生成之间的表示边界会变薄，系统也可能减少“检索分数高但生成器不用”的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 INTRA，核心是用同一个 pretrained encoder-decoder 的表示空间同时做 evidence selection 和 answer generation。每个 corpus chunk 先由 encoder 编成 token-level states，并作为可复用的 evidence memory。检索阶段不引入独立 retriever，而是在 decoder 输入中加入 R 个可训练 retrieval tokens，使 decoder cross-attention 产生 query-side retrieval states。然后用类似 ColBERT 的 late interaction，把 decoder query states 与每个 chunk 的 encoder token states 做 token-level matching，再聚合成 chunk-level retrieval score。被选中的 encoded chunks 不需要还原成文本再重新编码，而是直接作为 decoder cross-attention memory 参与生成。这个设计的关键取舍是：它不是要替代大规模语料库上的工业检索系统，而是在固定知识库和多跳 QA 这类设置中减少 retriever-generator mismatch，并摊销静态 evidence 的编码开销。
summary.experiments: 论文在问答任务上评估 evidence recall 和 end-to-end answer quality，重点强调多跳 QA 场景。根据正文描述，INTRA 在证据召回和最终回答质量上优于强工程化 retrieval pipelines，并且这些 pipelines 通常依赖大规模训练数据或独立检索模块。实验还分析了 reusable-context regime：静态 evidence 只需编码一次，后续 query 复用 encoder states，因此计算开销从反复长上下文编码转向检索 query 与预编码 memory 的匹配。当前给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格数字，因此不应把性能幅度外推到更大开放语料检索场景。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Method 中 encoder chunk states、decoder retrieval tokens、cross-attention query 暴露方式，以及 ColBERT-style late interaction 如何从 token-level attention/matching 得到 chunk score。实验部分优先看多跳 QA 的 evidence recall、answer quality 对比，以及计算分析中“预编码 evidence 跨 query 复用”的成本模型。若关注预训练，可以重点思考这种接口是否需要在预训练阶段加入 retrieval-token 或 memory-selection 目标，而不是只在下游 QA 上适配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the separation between retrieval and generation in standard RAG. External retrievers select evidence in one representation space, while the generator consumes the selected text in another pass. The question is whether a pretrained encoder-decoder can retrieve from its own encoded evidence states and then reuse those same states for generation.
summary_en.importance: The direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but the architectural signal is useful. INTRA treats attention as a query-conditioned retrieval interface rather than only as an internal computation inside generation. This matters for memory-augmented models, long-context alternatives, and encoder-decoder pretraining: if static evidence can be encoded once and reused across queries, the boundary between retrieval and generation becomes less rigid, and the retriever-generator mismatch can be reduced.
summary_en.technical_approach: INTRA uses a single pretrained encoder-decoder representation space for both evidence selection and answer generation. Corpus chunks are encoded into token-level encoder states and stored as reusable memories. At retrieval time, the decoder input is augmented with R trainable retrieval tokens, exposing decoder-side query states through cross-attention. A ColBERT-style late-interaction scoring function compares these query states against the token states of each encoded chunk and aggregates the matches into chunk-level retrieval scores. The selected encoded chunks are then fed directly as decoder cross-attention memory for generation, without converting them back into raw text and re-encoding them. The design is not framed as a full replacement for large-scale industrial retrieval; it is better understood as a unified retrieval-generation interface for fixed evidence collections, especially when evidence can be pre-encoded.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates question answering with evidence recall and end-to-end answer quality, with an emphasis on multi-hop QA. The reported results indicate that INTRA outperforms strong engineered retrieval pipelines on both evidence selection and final answer quality, despite those pipelines using separate retrievers and often larger-scale retrieval training. The paper also studies the computation profile of the reusable-context setting: static evidence is encoded once, and later queries operate over cached encoder states. The provided content does not include the full result tables or exact margins, so the claims should be read as evidence for this setting rather than as a general statement about open-corpus retrieval at web scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The key parts are the method definitions for encoded chunk memories, decoder-side retrieval tokens, exposed cross-attention query states, and the ColBERT-style late-interaction chunk scorer. In the experiments, prioritize the multi-hop QA evidence-recall and answer-quality comparisons, then inspect the compute analysis for the pre-encoded-evidence regime. For pretraining researchers, the main question to carry forward is whether retrieval tokens or memory-selection objectives should be introduced during pretraining instead of being added only during downstream adaptation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把 retrieval 重新写成 attention memory access；若实验对比足够干净，这会影响你对 RAG 与原生记忆边界的判断，但先重点核查 baseline 是否公平。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it recasts retrieval as native attention-based memory access; if the comparisons are clean, it shifts how you think about the boundary between RAG and built-in memory, but audit the baselines first.

summary.core_problem: 讨论自进化 LLM Agent 在流式任务中如何从历史交互里学习“可复用技能”，并把技能策展（skills curation）从人工/启发式规则推进到可学习的长期策略。
summary.key_insights: 介绍 Google 的 SkillOS：将冻结的执行器（检索/应用技能）与可训练的策展器（更新外部 SkillRepo）解耦；用复合奖励为策展提供学习信号，并用“前期轨迹更新技能库、后期相关任务评估更新效果”的分组任务流来解决延迟反馈下的 credit assignment；宣称在多轮 agentic 任务与单轮推理任务上同时提升有效性与效率，并且策展器可跨执行器骨干与任务域泛化；观察到 SkillRepo 中的技能随时间演化为结构更丰富的 Markdown/元技能，带来更有针对性的技能调用。
summary.limits: 内容看起来是二手笔记式复述，缺少关键实验细节（奖励构成、训练稳定性、对比基线强度、成本/样本效率、失败案例）与可复现信息；与“基座预训练”关联偏间接，更偏向 agent 记忆/工具/技能库的后训练与系统设计。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make self-improving LLM agents learn reusable skills from streaming interactions, focusing on learnable skill curation rather than manual or heuristic updates.
summary_en.key_insights: Summarizes Google SkillOS: decouples a frozen executor (retrieves/applies skills) from a trainable curator that updates an external SkillRepo; uses a composite reward and a grouped task-stream setup where early trajectories modify the repo and later related tasks evaluate those modifications, addressing delayed-feedback credit assignment; reports consistent gains in effectiveness and efficiency on multi-turn agentic tasks and single-turn reasoning tasks, with curator generalization across executor backbones and domains; notes the repo evolves into more structured Markdown-like artifacts encoding higher-level meta-skills.
summary_en.limits: Appears to be a secondary, high-level recap with limited methodological detail (reward design, training dynamics, baseline rigor, compute/sample efficiency, failure modes) and no reproducibility pointers; relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect, leaning more toward post-training/system-level agent learning.

## The other half of context learning

To truly solve real

summary.core_problem: 研究模型在更接近真实生活的杂乱、动态、未整理上下文中进行 context learning 的能力，而不是在人工清洗好的上下文里取巧。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark/评测设定上的修正：它不直接提出新预训练方法，但对如何评估长上下文、在线学习、记忆与检索能力有现实约束意义，能暴露很多在干净 benchmark 上看不见的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 CL-Bench 家族扩展出 CL-Bench Life，核心思路是把上下文从“预先整理、结构清晰、任务友好”的输入，替换为更贴近现实生活的信息流与环境噪声，考察模型从原始上下文中筛选、推理、记忆和持续利用信息的能力。博客明确强调此前 benchmark 给了模型一个过大的 shortcut。
summary.experiments: 从提供信息看，论文配套有项目页、代码仓库和 Hugging Face 数据集，但当前摘要未给出具体模型规模、参评模型名单、任务构成和量化结果。可合理预期实验会对比现有 LLM 在原版 CL-Bench 与更真实场景上的性能落差，并分析 context organization 对结果的影响；是否有强结论需以论文正文为准。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯混元团队博客解读，关联 CL-Bench Life 论文、代码与数据。作者 Shihan Dou、Pluto Zhou 来自 Tencent Hunyuan 语境；博客的重点是指出既有 context-learning 评测过于“干净”，低估了真实世界上下文处理难度。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies whether models can perform context learning in messy, dynamic, real-life context streams rather than in neatly curated inputs that make the task artificially easy.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark/evaluation correction rather than a new pretraining method, but it matters because it exposes failure modes in long-context, memory, and retrieval behavior that clean benchmarks often hide.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work extends the CL-Bench family with CL-Bench Life. The key move is to replace pre-organized, task-friendly context with more realistic information streams and environmental noise, then test whether models can filter, reason over, remember, and reuse relevant information. The blog explicitly argues that prior setups gave models an oversized shortcut.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided context, there is a project page, code, and a Hugging Face dataset, but no concrete model sizes, evaluated systems, task breakdown, or quantitative numbers are shown here. The likely experimental focus is the performance gap between original clean-context settings and more realistic settings, plus analysis of how context organization affects outcomes; the strength of the claims depends on the paper itself.
summary_en.authors_note: Tencent Hunyuan blog post tied to the CL-Bench Life paper, code, and dataset. The framing emphasizes that existing context-learning evaluations are too clean and understate the difficulty of real-world context handling.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作不改训练范式，但会改你看长上下文结果的口径；先看任务构造和 clean-vs-messy 的性能落差，若掉点很大，内部评测集该重做。
recommendation.en: It will not change your training objective, but it may change how you trust long-context numbers; read the task construction and the clean-vs-messy gap first.

paper.title: MEMCoder: Multi-dimensional Evolving Memory for Private-Library-Oriented Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at general code generation, but their performance drops sharply in enterprise settings that rely on internal private libraries absent from public pre-training corpora. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offers a training-free alternative by providing static API documentation, we find that such documentation typically provides only isolated definitions, leaving a fundamental knowledge gap. Specifically, LLMs struggle with a task-level lack of coordinatio

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在企业私有库代码生成中不了解内部 API 用法、参数约束和跨 API 协作模式的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码生成系统方法。它不是预训练工作，但触及一个真实缺口：私有库知识很难出现在公开预训练语料中，静态 RAG 文档又常常只给 API 定义，不能教会任务级组合模式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MEMCoder，一个面向私有库的多维演化记忆框架。系统从模型自己的解题轨迹中蒸馏 Usage Guidelines，并沿任务级 API 协作模式和 API 级参数/边界条件两条维度累积更新；推理时使用 dual-source retrieval，同时注入静态文档和动态记忆。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、私有库 benchmark 名称、baseline 和提升幅度。可确认的对比对象包括 training-free 的静态文档 RAG，目标场景是 enterprise/private-library-oriented code generation。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tsinghua University College of AI。未能从给定信息确认作者在代码模型或 LLM 预训练方向的知名代表作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses code generation for enterprise private libraries, where LLMs lack knowledge of internal APIs, parameter constraints, boundary cases, and coordination patterns across APIs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a code-generation system method rather than pretraining. The useful observation is that private-library knowledge is absent from public pretraining corpora, and static RAG over API docs often provides definitions without executable usage patterns.
summary_en.technical_approach: MEMCoder introduces a multi-dimensional evolving memory. It distills usage guidelines from the model's own problem-solving trajectories, maintaining task-level API coordination patterns and API-level parameter or boundary-condition knowledge. At inference time, dual-source retrieval injects both static documentation and evolved memory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, benchmark names, baseline details, or improvement numbers. The main baseline implied is training-free static documentation RAG, and the target setting is private-library-oriented code generation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the College of AI at Tsinghua University. No widely known prior work by the listed authors in code models or LLM pretraining can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和记忆更新规则即可；它对预训练无直接动作，但私有 API 的知识形态分析是有用负样本。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and memory-update rule only; it does not change pretraining, but its analysis of private-API knowledge is a useful failure case.

paper.title: Memory Transfer Learning: How Memories are Transferred Across Domains in Coding Agents

summary.core_problem: 研究跨域记忆是否、以及为何能提升 coding agent：把不同基准/不同任务域产生的“记忆”（轨迹、工作流、摘要、洞见等）放入统一记忆池，在目标任务推理时检索使用，评估跨域迁移收益与负迁移来源。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练/数据/Scaling 的直接关联较弱，更偏 agent 记忆与推理时自进化；但有两点可迁移启发：1）“抽象层级决定可迁移性”与预训练数据压缩/知识蒸馏的直觉一致——高层 meta-knowledge 比低层实例更跨域；2）统一记忆池的收益主要来自可复用的验证/调试/环境操作套路，提示在后训练数据合成或 RL pretrain 中，显式强化这类程序性元技能可能比堆更多同域样本更有效。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是系统性实验框架而非新模型：
- 先在多个 coding 基准上运行同一类 agent，离线收集推理-行动-观察轨迹作为原始经验；
- 用四种记忆表示把经验压缩成不同抽象度：Trajectory（低抽象、细节多）、Workflow、Summary、Insight（高抽象、原则/策略）；
- 推理时做记忆检索，把检索到的记忆注入提示词/上下文以指导解题；
- 对比“同域记忆池”与“跨域统一记忆池”，并分析迁移来源（代码内容 vs 元知识）、抽象度与迁移增益的相关性、以及负迁移与规模效应（记忆池更大/域更多）。
summary.experiments: 作者在 6 个 coding benchmarks 上评测，报告跨域记忆带来平均 3.7% 的提升；并通过定性分析指出主要迁移的是 meta-knowledge（如验证例程、避免环境失败、先检查接口/结构再严格验证等），而非可直接复用的任务特定代码。还报告抽象度越高（Insight 类）跨域迁移越有效，低抽象轨迹更易干扰导致负迁移。你提供的正文片段未包含各基准逐项分数与显著性细节。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Figure 2（四类记忆表示）和主结果表（跨域 vs 同域、不同记忆格式的对比），再看机制分析部分（为什么是 meta-knowledge、抽象度如何量化、负迁移案例）。
- 预计阅读时间：30-45 分钟（以抓结论与设计要点为主）。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies whether heterogeneous, cross-domain memories can improve coding agents, and what actually transfers: build a unified memory pool from multiple coding benchmarks/domains, retrieve memories at inference time, and quantify gains, transfer mechanisms, and negative transfer.
summary_en.importance: Only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining, but it offers two useful angles: (1) transferability increases with abstraction level, echoing data compression/knowledge distillation intuitions (meta-knowledge > instance-level traces); (2) the main benefit comes from reusable operational routines (validation, debugging, environment constraints), suggesting post-training data synthesis or RL-style pretraining could focus more on these procedural meta-skills than on piling up more in-domain examples.
summary_en.technical_approach:
This is primarily a controlled experimental framework rather than a new architecture:
- Run a coding agent across multiple benchmarks and log trajectories (reasoning/action/observation) offline.
- Convert experiences into four memory representations with increasing abstraction: Trajectory, Workflow, Summary, Insight.
- At inference, retrieve relevant memories and inject them into the agent’s context/prompt.
- Compare in-domain memory pools vs a cross-domain unified pool; analyze what transfers (task code vs meta-routines), how abstraction correlates with transfer, and when negative transfer happens; also explore scaling with larger pools/more domains and potential cross-model transfer.
summary_en.experiments: Across 6 coding benchmarks, cross-domain memory yields an average +3.7% improvement. Qualitative analyses attribute gains mostly to meta-knowledge (validation routines, avoiding environment failures, inspect interfaces/structure first, then strict verification) rather than directly reusable task-specific code. Higher-abstraction memories (Insights) transfer better; low-level trajectories can distract and cause negative transfer. The excerpt provided does not include per-benchmark breakdown tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Start with the memory-format figure (the four representations) and the main results table comparing in-domain vs cross-domain pools.
- Then read the mechanism/ablation sections on meta-knowledge transfer, abstraction quantification, and negative transfer examples.
Estimated time: ~30–45 minutes for key takeaways.

recommendation.zh: 只看跨域正/负迁移的分解实验：高层“调试/验证套路”比低层轨迹更可迁移，可直接指导合成后训练数据时优先蒸馏程序性元技能。
recommendation.en: Skim the transfer/negative-transfer breakdown: it suggests reusable debugging/verification routines transfer better than raw traces, which is actionable for synthetic post-training data to distill procedural meta-skills.

paper.title: UI-Copilot: Advancing Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization

summary.core_problem: 如何提升基于多模态大模型(MLLM)的GUI自动化在长时序/长地平线任务中的稳定性与可控性，缓解记忆退化、进度混乱与数值/算术幻觉。
summary.importance: 提出“执行agent + 轻量copilot工具”的协作范式与对应的策略优化方法（TIPO），属于较通用的tool-use与长地平线训练框架探索；对后训练阶段如何学会选择性调用工具、以及记忆/计算能力模块化有启发。
summary.technical_approach: UI-Copilot框架：主GUI agent负责操作执行；轻量copilot按需提供两类能力（Retriever用于记忆检索、Calculator用于数值计算）。关键设计包括memory decoupling（持久观测与瞬时执行上下文分离）以及Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization (TIPO)：将工具选择学习（单轮预测）与任务执行学习（on-policy多轮rollout）分开优化，以提升工具调用的可学性与稳定性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体benchmark名称/规模与量化结果细节，仅描述针对长地平线GUI场景的改进；缺少模型参数量、训练数据/轨迹规模、与强基线（如纯ReAct/纯toolformer式调用/现有GUI agent训练法）的明确对比幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Improving long-horizon MLLM-based GUI automation by mitigating memory degradation, progress confusion, and numerical/math hallucinations.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a collaborative agent+copilot tool-use paradigm and a dedicated policy-optimization recipe (TIPO). It is a fairly general contribution to tool invocation learning and long-horizon agent training, offering insights for post-training and modular capability design.
summary_en.technical_approach: UI-Copilot: a GUI policy agent executes actions while a lightweight copilot provides on-demand assistance as a Retriever (memory) or Calculator (numerics). Uses memory decoupling to separate persistent observations from transient execution context. Proposes Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization (TIPO): optimize tool selection via single-turn prediction and task execution via on-policy multi-turn rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmark names, model/data scale, or numeric gains; it only claims improvements on long-horizon GUI scenarios. Strong-baseline comparisons are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 关注它如何把长地平线稳定性拆成“主策略+轻量工具copilot”并做策略优化；对后训练配方有用，但结论强度取决于任务/工具设定是否干净。
recommendation.en: Look at the decomposition into a main policy plus a lightweight tool-copilot with policy optimization; useful for post-training recipes, but strength depends on how clean the task/tool setup is.

paper.title: Transactional Attention: Semantic Sponsorship for KV-Cache Retention

summary.core_problem: 在极小 KV-cache 预算（如 K=16，仅占 4K 上下文的 0.4%）下，现有压缩/淘汰策略在“凭证检索”上会全军覆没（0%）。根因是 dormant tokens：例如 API key、密码、连接串等在大部分上下文中几乎不被注意力关注（attention mass≈0），但会在生成时刻突然变得必须逐字回忆。任何依赖注意力分数、重建损失或学习门控的保留策略都无法识别这类 token 的未来价值。
summary.importance: 提出 Transactional Attention（TA）：用“结构锚点→语义赞助”的机制，在 token 还没被用到之前就主动保护其邻近的值域 span，从而在极端预算下仍能 100% 召回凭证。该思路与现有 KV 压缩方法正交，可作为通用加成模块；并给出无需注意力的 TA-Fast 以兼容 FlashAttention/SDPA，面向真实 agent/tool 调用场景的长程状态保持。
summary.technical_approach:
TA 将 KV 保留从“统计显著性”转为“结构先验驱动的效用加成”。
1) 形式化：给定上下文 x1…xn，保留策略 π 在每步从 {1…n} 选子集 S，|S|≤K。每个 token i 有效用分 u_i，按 u_i 排序保留。
2) 失败机理：dormant token 在查询发生前对所有步的累计注意力 A_i<ε，因此任何以 A_i 或其变体为核心的策略都会把它排到很后。
3) 关键观察：dormant 但关键的信息往往遵循稳定的结构模式（如 “key:”“password:”“Authorization:” 等锚点后跟值）。这是高精度的领域结构信号。
4) Anchor detection（锚点检测）：提供三种实现：
- Regex：模式集合 P（key:/password:/…）直接匹配；
- Semantic：扩展到“said/told/remember”等提示记忆的动词结构；
- Embedding：用输入 embedding 与“锚点概念 embedding”的余弦相似做语言无关检测。
5) Utility scoring（效用函数）：为每个 token 构造复合效用 u_i，包含累计注意力 A_i、相对新近度 R_i=i/n、锚点指示 S_i、pension（历史注意力 EMA）、频次惩罚 F_i，以及核心的赞助券 V_i；论文给出一组固定权重 α=1.0, β=0.5, γ=0.3, δ=0.2, λ=0.1。
6) Voucher allocation（赞助券分配）：当检测到锚点 token x_i 时，为其后续 L 个 token 分配指数衰减的保护信号（由 sponsor budget B 控制，默认 B=15，L=6 贴合常见值域长度），把“结构锚点的语义重要性”注入到这些 token 的 u_i 中，从而在任何底层淘汰策略上都更不易被驱逐。
7) TA-Fast：提出不依赖注意力的变体以降低额外开销并兼容高效注意力实现；整体作为 scoring 侧的可组合模块，而非替换整个 eviction policy。
summary.experiments: 论文报告：在 K=16 的极端预算下，TA 在凭证检索任务上达到 100%，而 H2O、TOVA、SnapKV、StreamingLLM、PyramidKV、Dynamic 等六个基线为 0%；覆盖 3 个模型家族（Llama/Mistral/Phi）与 200 次 function-calling 试验。另有：学习式 anchor detector 可跨尺度迁移且 F1=0.946；TA 组合到现有方法上延迟开销 <1%，且在 LongBench 上不显著劣化长上下文通用能力（示例：42% vs TOVA 45%）。（具体设置与完整表格见正文实验部分与 Figure 1/2 等。）
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）
- Figure 1：dormant token 失败模式的直观证据（为什么注意力/重建信号都抓不到）。
- Method 章节：
  - 锚点检测三种实现的适用边界（regex vs embedding）、误报/漏报对保留预算的影响。
  - 复合效用 u_i 的各项设计动机，尤其是赞助券 V_i 的注入方式与衰减窗口（B、L）。
  - TA-Fast：如何做到 attention-free、与 FlashAttention/SDPA 的兼容点在哪里。
- 实验章节：
  - K=16 凭证检索主结果表（TA=100% vs baselines=0%）与跨模型复现。
  - 组合性实验（与不同压缩策略叠加）与开销评估（<1% latency）。
  - anchor detector 的训练/迁移设置与 F1=0.946 的证据。
skim（泛读）
- 读 Introduction + Figure 1/2：理解问题与“锚点赞助”四步流程。
- 快速扫 Method 中 u_i 公式与 voucher 分配规则（B、L、指数衰减）。
- 直接看主结果表与 LongBench 不退化结论，确认 TA 的收益与代价。
summary.authors_note: 作者的立场是：dormant token 的“未来重要性”无法从注意力统计中推断，但能从结构模式中高精度预测；因此应把领域结构先验显式注入 KV 保留打分。TA 的优势在于可组合与极端预算下的确定性召回；潜在风险在于锚点集合/检测器的覆盖面与误报导致的预算挤占，需要通过学习式 detector、频次惩罚与窗口设计来平衡。

summary_en.core_problem: Under tiny KV-cache budgets (e.g., K=16, 0.4% of a 4K context), existing KV compression/eviction methods collapse to 0% on credential retrieval. The root cause is the dormant token problem: credentials and configuration values receive near-zero attention throughout most of the context, yet become essential verbatim at unpredictable generation times. Any policy driven by attention scores, reconstruction loss, or learned retention gates fails because dormant tokens lack those statistical signals by definition.
summary_en.importance: Transactional Attention (TA) introduces a structural “semantic sponsorship” mechanism that proactively protects value-bearing spans adjacent to anchor patterns (e.g., “key:”, “password:”), achieving 100% credential retrieval at K=16 where multiple baselines get 0%. TA is designed to be orthogonal and composable with existing KV-cache compression methods, and includes TA-Fast, an attention-free variant compatible with SDPA/FlashAttention for practical deployment in agentic/tool-use settings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TA reframes retention from statistical salience to structure-prior utility boosting.
1) Setup: For context tokens x1…xn, a retention policy π selects a subset S⊆{1…n}, |S|≤K after each step. Each token i gets a utility u_i; top-u_i tokens are retained.
2) Why baselines fail: A dormant token has cumulative attention A_i<ε before the query, so any attention- or reconstruction-driven scoring ranks it near the bottom.
3) Key observation: Dormant-but-critical values follow predictable structural patterns; anchor tokens (e.g., “key:”, “Authorization:”) reliably precede value spans.
4) Anchor detection: three instantiations—(i) regex pattern set; (ii) semantic pattern extension (e.g., “said/told/remember”); (iii) embedding-based detection via cosine similarity to anchor concept embeddings (language-agnostic).
5) Utility scoring: TA defines a composite u_i combining cumulative attention A_i, recency R_i=i/n, anchor indicator S_i, a pension score (EMA of past attention), frequency penalty F_i, and a sponsorship voucher V_i; the paper provides fixed weights (α=1.0, β=0.5, γ=0.3, δ=0.2, λ=0.1).
6) Voucher allocation: when an anchor at position i is detected, it “sponsors” the next L tokens with exponentially decaying protection, controlled by sponsor budget B (defaults: B=15, L=6). This injects a proactive retention signal into u_i, making sponsored value tokens survive eviction even if their attention is ~0.
7) TA-Fast: an attention-free variant reducing overhead and remaining compatible with efficient attention kernels; TA modifies the scoring function rather than replacing the underlying eviction policy, enabling composition with existing methods.
summary_en.experiments: Reported results: at K=16, TA achieves 100% credential retrieval while six baselines (H2O, TOVA, SnapKV, StreamingLLM, PyramidKV, Dynamic) achieve 0%, validated across three model families (Llama, Mistral, Phi) and 200 function-calling trials. A learned anchor detector reaches F1=0.946 and transfers across scales without retraining. TA composes with existing methods with <1% latency overhead and does not materially degrade general long-context performance (e.g., LongBench 42% vs TOVA 45%). (See the paper’s main tables/figures for full settings.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep)
- Figure 1: the dormant-token failure mode and why attention/reconstruction signals miss it.
- Method section:
  - Anchor detection variants and their trade-offs (coverage vs false positives).
  - The utility u_i design, especially how voucher V_i is injected and decays (B, L).
  - TA-Fast: how it avoids attention dependence and stays compatible with SDPA/FlashAttention.
- Experiments:
  - The K=16 credential retrieval headline table (TA=100% vs baselines=0%) and cross-model replication.
  - Composition/overhead results (<1% latency) and LongBench non-degradation.
  - Anchor detector training/transfer evidence for F1=0.946.
skim (quick)
- Read Introduction + Figures 1/2 for the problem and the 4-step sponsorship pipeline.
- Skim the u_i formula and voucher allocation rule (B, L, exponential decay).
- Jump to the main results table and the LongBench/overhead summary.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s stance is that dormant-token importance is fundamentally non-inferable from attention statistics but highly predictable from structural patterns; therefore, KV retention should explicitly encode domain-structural priors via sponsorship. TA’s strength is deterministic recall under extreme budgets and composability; the main practical risk is anchor coverage/false positives consuming budget, mitigated via learned detectors, frequency penalties, and careful windowing.

recommendation.zh: 看 §3 机制和极小 K 下的凭证召回表就够；它提醒“低 attention≠低价值”，可直接加到你现有 KV 压缩管线做补丁。
recommendation.en: Only §3 and the tiny-K credential-recall table matter; the key takeaway is “low attention ≠ low future value,” and it’s an easy patch atop existing KV compression.

paper.title: MT-OSC: Path for LLMs that Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation

summary.core_problem: LLM在多轮对话中因指令/关键信息分散而“迷路”导致性能下降，同时直接拼接全历史会造成上下文窗口与成本问题；如何在不打断用户体验下压缩历史并保持任务性能。
summary.importance: 面向长对话与上下文管理的系统/Agent式方案：提出后台自动凝练历史的框架，直接对应真实产品形态（chat）中的成本-性能权衡；对构建通用对话Agent的记忆/摘要/选择性保留策略有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: MT-OSC（One-off Sequential Condensation）：引入Condenser Agent，在后台用少样本推理的Condenser生成凝练摘要/状态，并用轻量Decider选择性保留必要信息；目标是在多轮过程中持续压缩token并维持可用上下文。
summary.experiments: 在多轮10-turn对话中最高减少token数达72%；在多种多轮benchmark上评测，并覆盖13个SOTA LLM；结论为能缩小多轮性能差距、在多数据集上提升或保持准确率。摘要未给出具体benchmark名称、模型清单与定量提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Prevent LLMs from getting “lost” in multi-turn conversations where key instructions are dispersed, while avoiding the cost and context-window limits of naively concatenating full dialogue history.
summary_en.importance: Targets practical long-conversation context management by proposing an always-on background condensation mechanism that trades tokens for performance without disrupting user experience, relevant to chat products and agent memory design.
summary_en.technical_approach: MT-OSC (One-off Sequential Condensation) introduces a background Condenser Agent that produces condensed summaries/state via few-shot prompting, and a lightweight Decider that selectively retains necessary information, continuously compressing context across turns.
summary_en.experiments: On 10-turn conversations, reports up to 72% token reduction and evaluations across multiple multi-turn benchmarks and 13 state-of-the-art LLMs, claiming reduced multi-turn degradation and accuracy improvements or preservation; the abstract omits benchmark names, model list, and exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 更像产品侧对话记忆工程，训练启发弱；只需扫方法流程和消融，看看压缩是否真不伤关键指令。
recommendation.en: Mostly product-style memory engineering, little pretrain signal; skim the pipeline + ablations to see if compression truly preserves instruction-critical bits.
